sections.body: An elephant is BIGGER than a mouse. A mouse is SMALLER. 🐘🐭
A long snake 🐍 and a short worm 🪱. Long and short!
A PATTERN repeats: 🍎🍌🍎🍌🍎… What comes next? 🍌!
Make a pattern with spoons and forks, or two colours of blocks.
Use words like more, fewer, longer and taller in daily life. Clapping patterns (clap, clap, stamp) also count!

quiz.q: Which is LONGER? 🐍 snake or 🐜 ant?
hints: Imagine them lying in a line.
A bus is longer than a car. Which animal here is longer?
quiz.explain: The snake is much longer than the ant! 🐍
The pattern is yellow, green, so green 🟢 comes next!
